name: Police Academy Roleplay 2
desc:
🚔 WELCOME TO HIGHFIELD CITY POLICE DEPARTMENT V3

Experience life inside a busy police academy where every role matters.

👮 Join the Police Department, attend training's, patrol the academy and progress through the ranks.
🛡️ Join specialist divisions including SWAT, Academy Security Unit, Traffic Unit and more!
💥 Prefer the other side? Play as a civilian, gear up, raid the academy or unlock powerful Raider classes.
💰 Earn money, purchase weapons and equipment, claim daily rewards and unlock new gear.
🎯 Train. Patrol. Raid. Progress. Build your reputation.

Whether you want serious police roleplay, tactical combat or simply to explore Highfield with friends, there is always something happening.

⭐ HCPD V3 is a complete rebuild featuring new systems, gameplay, equipment, vehicles and much more.

Join today and begin your career.
